subtitle: Student & Developer
about: I’m a programming enthusiast, always seeking to grow and fill the gaps in my knowledge. I find it exciting to create programs, fix bugs, and explore new techniques by learning from more experienced professionals.
tatakonDesc: Raycasting project developed in Java using only the Swing library for graphical rendering, simulating a 3D environment from a 2D map through mathematical ray projection calculations.
scaffaleDesc: Scaffale is a personal reading diary where you can search for books, organize your shelf, and log ratings and notes. It features an authentication system, light/dark theme, and built-in search powered by the Open Library API. It uses modern frameworks as Node.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS.
portfolioDesc: Portfolio developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript throughout the entire application. The project features smooth animations, a responsive design, internationalization (i18n) supporting English and Portuguese languages, and a dark mode for an enhanced user experience.
ubuntuServerDesc: Linux Ubuntu server configuration featuring a DHCP server, dual NIC setup, two web application instances running Apache and Nginx connected to PostgreSQL and MariaDB respectively, file sharing via Samba, and a self-hosted personal cloud using Nextcloud, exposed to the web through Cloudflare Tunnels.
